---
title: "Rhinovirus_cases"
---

# Load data

Set paths to data directory and output directory
```{r}
data_path = "path/to/data"

output_path  = "path/to/save/outputs"
```

```{r}
rhino <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "Rhinovirus_cases.csv"), sep=";", header=TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
pal <- c("#7B71B6", "#E06666")

rhino_cases <- rhino %>%
  mutate(Month=factor(Month, levels=c(4:12,1:3))) %>%
  ggplot(data=., aes(x=Month, y=cases, group=Year_cat)) +
  geom_line(aes(color=Year_cat), linewidth = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c("2020-2021"=pal[1], "2024-2025"=pal[2]), name="") +
    
    labs(y="Cases (N)", x="") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("4"="April", "5"="May", "6"="June", 
                                 "7"="July", "8"="Aug.", "9"="Sept.", 
                                 "10"="Oct.","11"="Nov.", 
                                 "12"="Dec.", "1"="Jan.",
                                 "2"="Feb.", "3"="March")) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
          legend.title = element_text(""),
          legend.text = element_text(size=12))

ggsave(rhino_cases, 
       file = paste0(output_path, "rhino_cases.jpg"), 
       width = 7.2, height = 4, units = "in", dpi=300)
```
